title: Ordinary realization preserves the bare clopen projector
statement: Let R_n be any sequence of commutative rings with transition homomorphisms, let n be a natural number, and let s:U→X be a clopen immersion. For any ordinary varying-ring module system M on X, write E_X for ordinaryRealization and g_s,j_s for the specified ordinaryPullComparison and ordinaryOpenComparison of [lem-sp-varying-ring-ordinary-evaluation-comparisons]. With modulePi of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows] and strict pi of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], E_X(modulePi_s(M)); j_s(s^*M); J_s(g_s(M)) equals pi_s(E_X M). Only one immersion and its projector enter this identity: there is no cartesian beta, no outgoing open extension and no outgoing compositor.

source.place: Tag 09AE, Definition extension-zero and Lemma open-immersion; together with more-etale.tex, Tag 0F7B, open case, and Zheng Construction 4.1. The ordinary-to-constant-derived-tower normalization is an agent-formulated consequence, not a verbatim assertion of these sources.

proof.text: For an adjoint triple J⊣G⊣P with fully faithful J and invertible canonical J→P comparison, cancel G of this comparison and use the triangle identity to show G(pi_M)=unit_(GM). Apply this to the ordinary varying-ring triple. The strict-tower version is the existing pi_image calculation of its calculus.

Apply strict G to the realized ordinary projector and precompose with the invertible ordinary pullback comparison. Its naturality turns G of the realized projector into the realization of ordinary G(pi). Substitute the image identity and ordinaryOpen_mate. Naturality of the strict open unit then identifies the result with strict G(pi).

Both arrows have codomain strict J applied to strict G(E_X M). Postcompose with the invertible strict J→P comparison and transpose under strict G⊣P. Each transpose is strict G of the arrow followed by the same counit; the preceding equality makes them equal. Injectivity of the adjunction equivalence and cancellation of J→P prove the desired equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09AE, open immersion adjunctions and fully faithful extension; categorical calculation with the adjoint triple and the specified realization unit normalization.

from.place: Local pairs: the clopen projector calculation inside ordinary realization of the section factor.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryClopenProjectorEvaluation (n : ℕ) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (s : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s] (M : Modules R φ X) :
    (ordinaryRealization R φ n X).map ((modulePi R φ s).app M) ≫
        (ordinaryOpenComparison R φ n U X s).hom.app ((pull R φ s).obj M) ≫
        (StrictTower.J (R n) s).map ((ordinaryPullComparison R φ n U X s).hom.app M) =
      (StrictTower.pi (R n) s).app ((ordinaryRealization R φ n X).obj M)
